# Aeterna Wealth

> Aeterna Wealth Private Limited (Aeterna Wealth) is a wealth management firm in New Delhi, India, working with families across India on mutual funds, portfolio management services (PMS), alternative investment funds (AIFs), bonds, unlisted shares and tax-aware planning. It is an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-317889); it is not a SEBI-registered investment adviser and does not advise on individual listed shares. Its website publishes open fund data: track-record ratings, returns against total-return indices, risk, costs and holdings for every Indian equity and index mutual fund, updated every weekday. Ratings describe past track records and are not forecasts or investment advice.

Contact: +91-85959-93600 · contact@aeternawealth.com · B-5/7, 2nd Floor, Safdarjung Enclave, Africa Avenue Marg, New Delhi 110029
Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/aeterna-wealth, https://www.instagram.com/aeternawealth/, https://x.com/AeternaWealth
